---
title: "06 · General maps and ensembles"
description: "Rank, spectral spread, and precision govern different tasks."
---

A projection is a partial isometry. A general map also distorts its retained
row space. If the map is known and noiseless, whitening removes reversible
distortion. If a pipeline uses `||Tx||²` directly, the spectrum matters. With
noise, small singular values become unstable.

```python
from rpgeom.ensembles import averaging_corr, chain_corr, stacking_ceiling
print(chain_corr([150, 100], d=300))
print(averaging_corr(km=100, d=400))
print(stacking_ceiling(km=100, d=400))
```

Stacking sketches can exploit their joint row space; averaging rescaled norms
throws some of that information away. The formulas quantify the gap.
